prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Hard film-noir chiaroscuro with the colour pushed far beyond nature: a red light on one side and cold cyan slats of light through a venetian blind on the other. Camera low on the back stairs looking up past a dark banister post. A heavy-set gangster in a chalk-stripe suit and grey fedora, with a broad pockmarked face, a flattened boxer's nose and a toothpick, leans his mouth to the open slot of a plain steel door, where two wary eyes look out. His face large, right of centre. A crate of empty bottles, a fire bucket, a wet stone floor holding every light as a streak. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
